name: problem-scene
description: Hub problem section: centred heading and lede over two overlapping photos with four coloured chips around them, then a panda CTA bar. Live: #ap-gov-problem on the industry hubs.

background.description: Soft colour-wash image behind the section.

images.description: Two photos. Each: image, alt. Each may carry x, y, w, h (% of the scene) to place and size it; the scene then takes its height from scene_height.

chips.description: Up to five chips (blue, red, green, yellow placements, then a fifth). Each: text, tone; icon (URL) or icon_svg; optional desktop placement left, right, top (CSS lengths, auto, or calc/min/max).

scene_height.description: Height of the photo scene in px. 0 keeps the default 260.

variant.description: readiness: the Emergency Preparedness / School Reunification problem section, which stacks at 900px into one column with full-width callouts (the hubs stack at 1024px). eduhub: the Education hub (live #ap-eduhub-problem, ported whole): the photo pair and four chips stay side by side, scaling with the width, down to 641px; at 640px and below the scene becomes one photo and four full-width chips over mobile_background. The eduhub chips take their colour and place from their order; left, right and top are ignored.

mobile_background.description: eduhub only: the colour wash behind the section at 640px and below (live swaps in a phone image). Empty keeps background.

stack.description: Width at which the layout stacks: 1024px (the hubs) or 900px (the Education hub).
